mechanicalFailureFinding.canonicalHardStopExpected: effective path 230 or greater must never be used directly
mechanicalFailureFinding.cause: The runner calls canonical.is_file/stat and an asserting direct-use budget before the alias, while the later O3F14 owned alias context would call os.path.samefile on the same 239-effective canonical leaf. R11 itself receives only aliasPath.

sourceHandlingOptions.name: PREDECLARED_SOURCE_PATH_HOLDS_AND_ELIGIBLE_EXECUTION
sourceHandlingOptions.design: Record every canonical-direct-use-unsafe historical row as a source-path hold and execute all remaining eligible pairs.
sourceHandlingOptions.rejectionReason: This preserves safety but unnecessarily withholds a pair whose unchanged provider-facing path is already the exact same bytes through a verified 146-effective-character alias. It would convert transport-path provenance into a detector hold.

sourceHandlingOptions.name: SHORT_PHYSICAL_SAME_HASH_STAGING_COPY
lawfulOnlyWithAdditionalAuthority: Prove a fresh short D: staging root, free space, collision behavior, and full return-path budget.
Read source bytes through a safe verified alias, stream-copy to create-new partial files, verify bytes and SHA-256, atomically finalize, and sign canonical-to-stage mappings.
Define retained/quarantined staging and exact owned cleanup semantics without source deletion.
sourceHandlingOptions.rejectionReason: The child contract already accepts the short alias path, and the selected O3F15-owned context can prove its exact mapping without touching the canonical leaf. Physical copying adds image reads, destination writes, disk-capacity and rollback premises, and staging lifecycle without shortening the consumer path.

sourceHandlingOptions.name: NONASSERTING_CANONICAL_DIRECT_USE_CLASSIFICATION_WITH_REQUIRED_VERIFIED_ALIAS
lawfulDesign: Measure and classify every canonical provenance path lexically; never call is_file, stat, resolve, hash, open, samefile, or any other filesystem API on a canonical leaf whose direct use is unsafe.

Use exact boundary semantics: effective length below 200 is direct-safe; 200 through 229 requires a verified short alias; 230 or greater is a hard stop for direct use and may proceed only through a separately pre-gated alias with zero canonical filesystem touch.
For the signed 239-effective canonical leaf, record directUseAllowed=false and verifiedShortAliasRequired=true; never place canonicalPath in a child argument or job input path.
Pre-gate both the short slot root and constructed alias below 200 before mapping, output-root creation, job creation, or process launch.
Implement an O3F15-owned Q: context using only the frozen O3F14 low-level mapping inventory/query/create/remove primitives. Do not modify O3F14 and do not reuse its owned_case_alias context.

Verify the exact normalized subst target, the exact lexical canonical slot-root plus BF/DF relative suffix relationship, and alias-only is_file/stat metadata before yield. R11 then performs stat, pinned hash verification, and decode only through aliasPath.
Preserve canonicalPath only as immutable lexical provenance; never append suffixes, write through it, rename it, or pass it to R11.
Finally remove only the owned Q: mapping and prove unrelated mappings remain unchanged.
Classify all 978 rows completely before build/live authority and require zero unknown, duplicate, or omitted identities.
minimumNegativeControls: Exact Slot19 BF raw 207 plus reserve 32 records directUseAllowed=false and verifiedShortAliasRequired=true while alias effective 146 passes.
Canonical effective 199 is direct-safe; 200 and 229 require an alias; 230 is a direct-use hard stop and allows only the zero-canonical-touch alias path.
Slot-root and alias effective 199 pass; either at effective 200 fails closed before mapping, output-root creation, or child launch.
A canonical-direct-use-unsafe row is never passed to is_file, stat, resolve, hash, open, samefile, a child argument, or a job input path.
A failed Q: ownership, exact mapping, lexical suffix, alias-only metadata, or cleanup assertion remains a technical hold with no retry.
A safe control following an alias-required historical row remains scheduled in the synthetic/file-backed harness.
sourceHandlingOptions.whySmallest: It replaces the incorrect canonical filesystem/direct-use premise and adds only an O3F15-owned zero-canonical-touch alias context. The frozen O3F14 and R11 bytes stay unchanged. No image copy, new staging root, detector hold, threshold change, or selector change is needed.

policySupportedRemedyMeaning: One bounded local contract correction removes every unsafe canonical filesystem touch while preserving the direct-use hard stop, verified alias requirement, frozen O3F14/R11, and all detector invariants.
